resolution_refinements.resolve_jurisdiction: resolve target/operator/device/deployment/distribution/data subjects before law; capability alone yields TOKEN_VAZIO
resolution_refinements.resolve_authority_hierarchy: official OS/license authority > material license/SPDX > local README/control > narrative
resolution_refinements.semantic_contextualize: technical terms for instrumentation, privileged access and runtime compilation are capability descriptors, not conclusions of illegality or maliciousness
resolution_refinements.cross_cultural_semantic_diff: security vocabulary may map differently across jurisdictions; legal equivalence remains AMBIGUOUS until actual conduct/rule is resolved
resolution_refinements.detect_normative_conflict: flag heterogeneous license topology and any leap from capability to authorized/lawful use
resolution_refinements.protected_subject_gate: enhanced review activates only when actual processing touches children, health, biometrics or other protected/sensitive subjects
resolution_refinements.evidence_and_conformance_gate: selftest/security feature/documentation validates only its scoped gate; runtime authorization, privacy compliance and certification remain separate
resolution_refinements.temporal_validity: bind conclusions to repo/ref/path/blob and relevant OS/policy version
resolution_refinements.provenance_chain: repo/ref/path/blob -> capability -> target/deployment -> authority/license -> data/resource -> NormativeAtom -> evidence -> status
